scope: Observer-only fix; no experiment core, run ledger, service, campaign, or watcher process changed. Live snapshot sampled read-only without publishing.
root_cause: PermissionError returned None, which was conflated with absent supervisor state and stopped the watcher.
fixes: Windows FILE_SHARE_READ|FILE_SHARE_WRITE|FILE_SHARE_DELETE read handles; close before JSON parsing.
Up to six reads with bounded 0.05/0.1/0.2/0.4/0.8 second delays.
Unavailable state preserves last known same-run supervisor data with an explicit stale flag; no history reports unknown.
Unknown state or process liveness continues watching; confirmed process exit or fresh terminal state stops.
Windows_sharing_limit: Shared-delete permits rename of an open file; MoveFileEx/os.replace can still require the existing writer retry until the read handle closes. No claim of guaranteed lock-free replacement.
